key: DLSS-NR (Experimental)
source: DLSS-NR (Experimental)

key: Enable &DLSS-NR
source: Enable &DLSS-NR

key: Runs every frame through the DLSS-NR neural rendering model. Very slow and experimental.
source: Runs every frame through the DLSS-NR neural rendering model. Very slow and experimental.
translation: Kör varje bildruta genom DLSS-NR:s neurala renderingsmodell. Mycket långsam och experimentell.

key: Use Frame &History
source: Use Frame &History

key: Feeds the previous filtered frame back into the model, for steadier motion. Unchecked, every frame is filtered on its own exactly as the nr_frame command filters a picture, and the filter runs faster.
source: Feeds the previous filtered frame back into the model, for steadier motion. Unchecked, every frame is filtered on its own exactly as the nr_frame command filters a picture, and the filter runs faster.
translation: Skickar tillbaka föregående filtrerade bildruta till modellen för jämnare rörelser. När alternativet inte är markerat filtreras varje bildruta självständigt, precis som kommandot nr_frame filtrerar en bild, och filtret körs snabbare.

key: Adaptive &Frame Rate
source: Adaptive &Frame Rate

key: Runs the model less often while the game falls short of its full frame rate at the current throttle, so a laptop that heats up keeps the game at speed. The picture keeps its frame rate; the filtering refreshes less often.
source: Runs the model less often while the game falls short of its full frame rate at the current throttle, so a laptop that heats up keeps the game at speed. The picture keeps its frame rate; the filtering refreshes less often.
translation: Kör modellen mer sällan när spelet inte når sin fulla bildfrekvens vid den aktuella begränsningen, så att en varm bärbar dator ändå håller spelet i rätt hastighet. Bilden behåller sin bildfrekvens, men filtreringen uppdateras mer sällan.

key: Compose at S&caled Height
source: Compose at S&caled Height

key: Works the correction out at Scaled Height and spreads it over the frame, rather than at the frame's own size. Much faster at the large scale factors, and it leaves the display filter's own detail on screen -- composed at full size the correction replaces it with the model's scaled-up output. The picture is sharper, and no longer the model's exactly.
source: Works the correction out at Scaled Height and spreads it over the frame, rather than at the frame's own size. Much faster at the large scale factors, and it leaves the display filter's own detail on screen -- composed at full size the correction replaces it with the model's scaled-up output. The picture is sharper, and no longer the model's exactly.
translation: Beräknar korrigeringen vid den skalade höjden och sprider ut den över bildrutan i stället för vid bildrutans egen storlek. Det går mycket snabbare vid stora skalningsfaktorer och bevarar skärmfiltrets egna detaljer. Om korrigeringen komponerades i full storlek skulle de ersättas av modellens uppskalade utdata. Bilden blir skarpare, men inte längre exakt modellens.

key: &Pre-filter
source: &Pre-filter

key: Run DLSS-NR on the emulated image, then let the display filter scale the result. The cheapest: the model sees the unscaled frame.
source: Run DLSS-NR on the emulated image, then let the display filter scale the result. The cheapest: the model sees the unscaled frame.
translation: Kör DLSS-NR på den emulerade bilden och låter sedan skärmfiltret skala resultatet. Billigast: modellen ser den oskalade bildrutan.

key: P&ost-filter
source: P&ost-filter

key: Run DLSS-NR over the display filter's output, at the filtered size.
source: Run DLSS-NR over the display filter's output, at the filtered size.
translation: Kör DLSS-NR på skärmfiltrets utdata i den filtrerade storleken.

key: At display si&ze
source: At display si&ze

key: Scale the display filter's output up to the size it is shown at and run DLSS-NR over that, as over a screenshot of the game. Scaled Height bounds the cost.
source: Scale the display filter's output up to the size it is shown at and run DLSS-NR over that, as over a screenshot of the game. Scaled Height bounds the cost.
translation: Skalar upp skärmfiltrets utdata till den visade storleken och kör DLSS-NR på den, som på en skärmbild av spelet. Skalad höjd begränsar kostnaden.
